profile.headline: Software Engineer at Evozyne, Astrophysics PhD
profile.summary: I am an Astrophysicist with a background in simulations, data analysis and visualization, nanofabrication, and superconducting detectors. I have strong passions for data analysis and optimizing software to run more efficiently.

positions.title: Research Analyst
positions.description: Bayesian analysis of simulated data for observational forecasting. Development of software package for analysis and display of resonances. Design, fabrication, and testing of microwave kinetic inductance detectors. Operation of a BlueFors Helium-3 dilution refrigerator.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Machine Learning · Mathematica · Plotly · Nanofabrication · MATLAB · Git · Python (Programming Language) · MySQL · Cryostat · SQL · Fortran · Bayesian inference

positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Studied the effects of the adiabatic index on a galactic wind model. Analyzed result of adding a dark matter halo to a galactic wind model. Created a central-differencing solver for the Euler equations of gas dynamics with source terms representing galactic winds. Studied the effects of multiple shocks produced by galactic winds.
positions.insights: Skills: Higher Education Research · Exploratory Data Analysis · Linux · Mathematica · C++ · Software Infrastructure · MATLAB · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Fortran

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Created a script to analyze mapping of bolometers on the South Pole Telescope. Constructed a website to view the transfer status of South Pole Telescope data and quickly assess data quality of observations.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Node.js · JavaScript · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Data Analysis

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Built a cloud-scale data processing pipeline framework. Performed signal processing on real-time radio antenna data streams
positions.insights: Skills: Linux · Data Science · CUDA · Cloud Computing · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Computer Networking
